messages:
paul: Quick kickoff for Celestia co-marketing. Scope: joint benchmark post (long-context summarization workload), Celestia Marketplace listing, and a technical webinar. Targets: webinar 12/7, blog 12/9, marketplace promo 12/10-12/16.
ivy: Topline goals: drive marketplace-attributed trials, measure 95th %ile latency on long-context (8k tokens) summarization, and show per-token delta on long requests.
chen: I'll own LP + marketplace blurb. Need a sanitized CSV + reproducibility notes from Eng by Wed so copy can lock.
omar: Eng will provide `celestia_longctx_bench.csv` and a short `readme.md` with model, sequence lengths, batch config, and tokenization notes by Tue EOD.
paul: Messaging guardrails: conservative phrasing only. Suggested: "Observed up to 24% lower token cost in our controlled long-context benchmark" and link to methodology. Call out workload shape (single long requests, multi-turn summarization).
kate: Ops routing: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign = "Celestia-MP-2026"; set hidden field origin=celestia_marketplace and partner_code=CEL-1226. Create webhook to #sdr-celestia and a Zap to create SFDC lead + assign to `sdr-integrations`.
ivy: Tracking: utm_source=celestia_marketplace, utm_campaign=celestia-longctx-1226, utm_medium=referral. Hidden form field `partner_tag=CEL-1226`. I'll drop the GTM snippet once LP is live.
chen: LP CTA: `Start Celestia marketplace trial` -> marketplace flow. I'll prepare 3 headline variants (technical/product/concise) and A/B test for 48h.
omar: Demo artifact: reproducible container `docker run redwood/celestia-demo:longctx -p 8080:8080 --config configs/longctx.yaml`. Will include sanitized metrics CSV only. No raw logs.
paul: Webinar format: 25m joint overview, 20m benchmark deep-dive, 15m live demo, 10m Q&A. Rehearsal week of 11/30.
sdr-bot: Rehearsal event created -> 1899300000 (calendar invite).
kate: Lead handling rules: if lead.company_size > 100 and intent indicates POC -> escalate to enterprise SDRs within 12h. Else route to integrations SDR pool. Add tags: marketplace=true, partner=celestia.
ivy: Retention automation: if marketplace signup ingests >20k tokens in first 14 days, create growth@redwood alert to discuss Dedicated options.
chen: Social strategy: two technical X threads (deep-dive + demo clip), one long-form LinkedIn, and 3 co-branded cards. I'll draft posts and short video clips.
paul: Legal dependency: Celestia legal to approve co-marketing brief and logo use by 11/20. If delayed, we can still host webinar but push public benchmark to 12/21.
kate: SFDC implementors: add web-to-lead hidden fields and ensure `campaign_membership` is set. Create auto-assignment rule: origin=celestia_marketplace -> queue `sdr-integrations`.
omar: For benchmark transparency: include reproducibility appendix with exact model name, tokenizer, seq_len, batch, concurrency, and sanitized CSV link. Avoid infra details.
ivy: Action recap: Chen (LP + social + headlines + FAQ), Paul (partner comms + webinar host), Omar (bench CSV + demo container + readme), Kate (SFDC rules + Zap + routing), Ivy (tracking + GTM + measurement).
paul: Final note: no public comms until legal signoff AND landing page live with tracking. Internal dry run on 12/1. Thanks team :rocket:
